assets.caption: Exact uploaded educational figure comparing DISI (upper) with VISI (lower). Left-to-right chain is radius, lunate, capitate, metacarpal. DISI describes lunate extension with compensatory capitolunate flexion; VISI describes lunate flexion with opposite compensation. Original screenshot credits Bednar JM and Osterman AL, Carpal Instability: Evaluation and Treatment, JAAOS 1993. Retain all original pixels and text.
